anchors.support: Nutrition Assessment is the first NCP step and its data support downstream diagnosis/intervention.
Assessment may draw from multiple sources and spans food/nutrition history, anthropometrics, biochemical/tests, physical findings and client history.
Critical thinking explicitly includes identifying and obtaining additional information and choosing valid tools/guidelines.

records.use_restriction: Does not define a universal mandatory-variable checklist or the final action for EP-NHANES-L-0001.

anchors.support: Defines adult BP categories, recommends lifestyle measures, and conditions treatment decisions on average BP and cardiovascular risk/context.
Confirms this is the current multisociety 2025 adult high-BP guideline replacing 2017 guidance.

records.version_caution: Correction lineage exists; exact full-text correction incorporation must be retained in downstream provenance.
records.use_restriction: Do not infer hypertension diagnosis or individualized diet prescription from the NHANES systolic observations alone.

anchors.support: Home monitoring can help confirm a high-BP diagnosis and does not replace professional evaluation.
Multiple readings should be taken and recorded during measurement.
Provides BP category ranges and states only a medical professional can confirm a diagnosis.
A single high reading is not enough for immediate conclusion; longitudinal readings provide a more complete picture.

records.use_restriction: Patient-facing guidance; use as boundary support, not as the sole clinical practice guideline.

anchors.support: Applicability requires known CVD-risk context and explicit risk assessment.
Behavioral counseling is a structured intervention, not a one-shot generic prescription.
Recommendation applies to adults with defined CVD risk factors and supports counseling in that target population.

records.temporal_caution: USPSTF page states the topic is being updated at the 2026-10-07 cutoff.
records.use_restriction: Cannot be directly projected onto the case until risk-factor status is appropriately established.

records.use_restriction: Supports general healthy-pattern context only; does not establish individualized recommendation sufficiency.
